lines.en: Yes! I played soccer in China for two years.
lines.zh: 是的！我在中国踢了两年足球。

lines.en: Great. What position do you play?
lines.zh: 太好了。你打什么位置？

lines.en: OK. I'll be there on Monday.
lines.zh: 好的，我周一会去的。

lines.en: See you then, Emma. Don't be nervous. Just have fun!
lines.zh: 到时见，艾玛。别紧张，玩得开心就好！

lines.en: At least we didn't lose. A tie is not bad.

lines.en: True. We'll win next time.

lines.en: Sounds good. See you then!
